title: Spicy Chicken and Pilaf Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken dish served with a side of pilaf, inspired by Indian cuisine.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped naga peppers and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the skillet and reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer the chicken until cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of pilaf on a plate, followed by a piece of the chicken.
Sprinkle with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
